The '''Meatlump Camps''' were camps established by the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I hope you make them pay... the foul, degenerate miscreants. Talus was much better off without Meatlumps, and I, for one, look forward to the day in which they are once again gone from this planet.|Sul Prine, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />}}
The Meatlump Camps were inhabited by a group of Meatlumps,<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" /> fanatical anti-technology thugs,<ref name="Meatlumps">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67782&month=052008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Meatlumps!}}</ref> led by the Meatlump lieutenant [[Strilath Farles]]. They had relocated from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to Talus since they were engaged in a violent conflict with a group of [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] criminals led by [[Gramo Murah]]. The camps were located in the mountains near the city of [[Nashal]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> those Meatlumps attacked [[Sul Prine]]'s [[Sul Prine's Place|house]] near the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] and smashed several [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. When [[Vani Korr]], a ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] who was investigating the Meatlumps, learned of this attack, she tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate. The spacer met Sul Prine and then used a map lost by one of the Meatlumps during the attack to localize their camp. The adventurer attacked the camp, killing some Meatlumps in the process, and forced the others to reveal the identity of their leader: Strilath Farles.<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Meatlump Camps were a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Meatlump Camps were added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> The Meatlump Camps appeared in the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Meatlumps Hideout|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 3]]." If the player starts this quest at the end of the game (combat level 90), the camps would be located on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a world for high-level players. Multiple story elements indicated that the quest was intended to be achieved at CL 65.<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />
